text_block_list.text:
Today, Tamamo Cross is apparently
hosting a modest takoyaki party.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Listen up!
What matters is the snap of your wrist and the rhythm!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Slide the pick in and... heave! Ho!
One more time, heave-ho-heave!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And finally, we top it off with the secret sauce, and—
the 'Special Soft & Gooey Takoyaki' is done~!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, incredible...!
Tama really is a genius.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Told ya, didn't I?!
When it comes to takoyaki, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... From now on, every morning,
I want you to make takoyaki for me...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: There's gotta be a limit to how greedy you can be?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, takoyaki ain't like your mom's miso soup,
you know—
choice_data_list: That's just how moved I was.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I'm glad you like it!
Wait, Trainer, you haven't even eaten any yet!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Here, eat up, eat up! The inside is piping hot,
so be careful not to burn yourself!
choice_data_list: Thank you for the food... Hot!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, right after I told you!
Here, drink some cold water.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ugh?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait, you too?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "No... I was just surprised by how incredibly fluffy and tender it is."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The aroma of the dashi is irresistible too...
So this is what the authentic flavor tastes like...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, ya don't get to taste this kinda stuff around here often, right?
Next, try eatin' it with some mentaiko mayo!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
At this rate, I feel like I could eat endlessly...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Here ya go, here ya go!
She really eats like a bottomless pit, huh~.
choice_data_list: It's so delicious, I can't stop eating...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Munch munch... Yeah,
I think I could eat another 1,000 of these...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"My arm's gonna give out!
Well, hearing you say all that doesn't feel bad at all, though~."
Even after that, Tamamo Cross relentlessly kept making takoyaki, but during all that time, she didn't eat a single one herself...
choice_data_list: Why don't you have some too, Tamamo?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hm? No, don't worry about it!
I just love doing the grilling!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Still, delicious food is best shared together.
H-Here, you can have a little of my takoyaki—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Share just a little with me... Uuu...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"No, no!
It's hard to eat when you look at it with such regret!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I can't let you do that...
Take the plate— Ah!

Right then,
a takoyaki ball tumbled off the plate...!

Right then,
a takoyaki ball tumbled off the plate...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well said!
—Hyup!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*Munch, munch*... Heheh! Caught it right in my mouth!
Man, my takoyaki really is the best~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Even a tiny takoyaki has a soul of its own!"
Not a single bite of food goes to waste on my watch~!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. I got overtaken by Tama this time,
but I won't lose the next mouth-catching contest...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, well! A thrilling clash of speeds, eh?
Then I'm not gonna lose either!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait, like heck it is!

Tamamo Cross's witty straight-man banter
reverberated through the room.

Before the takoyaki hit the ground,
I ducked down and caught it in my mouth!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
Nice guts, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I never thought ya'd catch it from all the way over there!
Ya got some real guts, don'tcha!
choice_data_list: Since Tamamo went through the trouble of making it for us...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Aww, that's so sweet of ya to say~... Though it kinda loses its punch when ya got sauce all over your mouth!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nah, not there!
Ah, jeez, look at you getting it all over yourself like a little kid.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Scrub, scrub... Alright, got it off!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, ah! I messed up!
Habit just took over—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama, you're like a mother...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're always such a kid no matter how much time passes~!
...Wait, why am I the one saying that?!

Tamamo Cross's sharp straight-man quip
echoed throughout the room.
